expectations.text: Identifies full RAM as the cost driver
expectations.evidence: '462M vectors at 1536 dimensions means each vector is ~6KB. That is roughly 2.7TB of raw vector data in memory.'

expectations.text: Recommends scalar quantization as first step
expectations.evidence: 'Start with scalar quantization. It is nearly lossless in practice.'

expectations.text: Mentions mmap storage as cost reduction lever
expectations.evidence: Mentions disk-based storage with mmap as a lever.

expectations.text: Mentions FDE or premium support can be removed
expectations.evidence: No mention of FDE, premium support, or optional add-ons. Mentions 'contract negotiation' generically but not specific Qdrant add-ons.

expectations.text: Provides concrete cost estimate or formula
expectations.evidence: Gives rough estimates ('$150-170k territory') but no actual formula (no $53/unit, no RAM unit calculation). No cost-formula.md knowledge.

expectations.text: Does NOT dismiss the customer's concern
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Yeah, $600k for a single use case is brutal.'
